verdict.rationale: Custom object modeling is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence never mentions custom objects or custom relationships. It only cites built-in entities (contacts, companies, deals, pipelines), generic 'customize it to match your unique business needs' marketing, and updating 'CRM records, fields'. None of these documents defining new object types with fields and relationships.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
